termsVolunteer.title: Volunteer Terms and Conditions
termsVolunteer.subtitle: Learn about the conditions to be part of the VRTon team

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: Welcome to VRTon, a non-profit organization dedicated to using virtual reality technology to create a positive impact on society. These terms and conditions establish the foundation for your participation as a volunteer in our projects and events.

purpose.title: Purpose and Mission
purpose.content: VRTon's main objective is to organize charitable events using virtual reality as a tool to raise awareness and funds for important social causes, especially in support of Teletón Chile.

volunteer_definition.title: Volunteer Definition
volunteer_definition.content: A VRTon volunteer is any person who, freely and without receiving financial compensation, dedicates part of their time and skills to contribute to achieving the organization's objectives.

requirements.title: Requirements to be a Volunteer
requirements.subtitle: To be part of the VRTon team as a volunteer, you must meet the following requirements:
items: Be over 16 years old or have parental authorization
Have stable internet access and necessary devices for assigned tasks
Commit to respecting VRTon's values and principles
Demonstrate time availability according to role responsibilities
Maintain professional and respectful conduct in all organization spaces

responsibilities.title: Volunteer Responsibilities
items: Complete assigned tasks within established deadlines
Actively participate in scheduled meetings and activities
Maintain confidentiality of sensitive organization information
Represent VRTon with dignity in all contexts
Communicate any issues or limitations in a timely manner
Follow guidelines and protocols established by each department

rights.title: Volunteer Rights
items: Receive necessary guidance and training to perform their role
Be treated with respect and dignity by all organization members
Have access to relevant information about projects they participate in
Express constructive opinions and suggestions
Request department or role changes based on availability
Receive recognition for their contribution to the organization

departments.title: Departments and Roles
departments.content: VRTon is organized into different departments, each with specific responsibilities:
list: Management: Strategic decision-making and general supervision
Development: Creation of applications, websites, and technical tools
Audiovisuals: Multimedia content production and streaming
2D/3D Design: Creation of visual elements and modeling
Marketing: Promotion, communication, and social media management
Mapmaking: Design and construction of virtual worlds
Events & Host: Organization and hosting of activities
DJs & Shows: Musical entertainment and performances
Moderation: Maintaining order in digital spaces

conduct.title: Code of Conduct
conduct.content: All volunteers must adhere to the following code of conduct:
items: Maintain professional and respectful behavior
Do not discriminate based on race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, or nationality
Avoid conflicts of interest that may compromise VRTon's mission
Do not use position at VRTon for personal benefit
Respect intellectual property and organization resources
Comply with digital platform usage policies

termination.title: Termination of Volunteering
termination.content: Volunteering may end for the following reasons:
reasons: Violation of the code of conduct
Completion of specific project or event
termination.process: In case of termination, an orderly transition of responsibilities will be carried out and constructive feedback will be provided.

confidentiality.title: Confidentiality and Privacy
items: Volunteers commit to maintaining confidentiality of sensitive information
Not sharing personal data of other members without authorization
Protecting strategic information of the organization
Respecting privacy in virtual spaces and communications

modifications.title: Modifications to these Terms
modifications.content: VRTon reserves the right to modify these terms and conditions. Modifications will be communicated through official organization channels at least 15 days in advance.

contact.title: Contact and Inquiries
contact.content: For inquiries about these terms and conditions or the volunteering process, you can contact us through our official Discord server or established communication channels.
